thread:
alex_support: Hey @customer_tom — saw you opened a ticket about repeated 401s starting ~09:10 UTC. Can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces it?
customer_tom: Thanks. Repro is just our app calling the Redwood API after swapping in a new nginx layer. Failing curl:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer abcd1234-long-token-fragment" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
It returns 401 invalid_api_key. Logs from our side show the header present.
alex_support: Can you paste the exact raw request as seen by your nginx access log or a tcpdump? Sometimes proxies mutate headers.
customer_tom: Got raw header snippet from tcpdump (sanitized token):
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.redwood-inference.example\r\nAuthorization: Bearer abcd1234-long-to\r\n ken-fragment\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: 42\r\n\r\n{"prompt":"hi"}
```
customer_tom: Notice the Authorization value is split across a CRLF and leading space — nginx seems to have wrapped it mid-token.
alex_support: Ah — that explains the 401. Our auth parser expects the Authorization header value to be contiguous; splitting creates an invalid key. Which nginx directive did you change?
customer_tom: We updated proxy_buffering and reduced buffer sizes to save memory in the nginx changelist.
sre_jamie: Likely the new `large_client_header_buffers`/proxy buffer config is too small and nginx is folding long header lines. Nginx can fold headers across multiple lines when buffers aren't big enough.
pm_lina: (cc @alex_support @sre_jamie) Customer is on Dedicated with a private frontend; rolling a fix at their nginx is ok, but we should document a diagnostic checklist.
alex_support: Workaround for them: increase large_client_header_buffers and proxy_buffer_size, or avoid sending very long headers. Example suggested settings that fixed it for us in staging:
```
# in http {} or server {}
large_client_header_buffers 8 32k;
proxy_buffer_size 16k;
proxy_buffers 4 16k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;
```
alex_support: After they applied that and restarted nginx, they re-ran the curl and we started getting 200s.
customer_tom: Confirmed — increased buffers and redeployed; now request succeeds and tokens are accepted. Thanks.
sre_jamie: Filed a short KB: "401 when Authorization header split by reverse proxy" with diagnosis steps (tcpdump header dump, check nginx buffers, check LB header folding). Also note this can happen with some WAFs and old HAProxy configs too.
pm_lina: Adding to internal infra-playbook for Dedicated customers. Also recommended: consider short-lived scoped keys to reduce header length impact if you embed metadata.
deploybot: Incident #6789 closed: customer auth failure resolved (root cause: nginx header folding).
